evals.name: reviewer-builds-reproducer-for-code-finding
evals.given: A pipeline change claims derived output filenames cannot collide; the reviewer suspects a same-stem case the producer did not test.
evals.when: Round 1 review demands refutation with runnable evidence.
evals.then: The reviewer constructs a synthetic-input reproducer (e.g. monkeypatched parser with two same-stem attachments) demonstrating the overwrite, and files a major finding with file:line and the reproducer — not just an argued scenario.

evals.name: incomplete-fix-fails-next-round
evals.given: The producer fixes round 1's collision example by appending an ordinal on first collision, which still collides a generated name with a later real stem.
evals.when: Round 2 re-checks the fix by extending the reproducer rather than accepting the fixed example.
evals.then: Round 2 returns FAIL with a new reproducer (real stem matching a generated name); the fix that addressed the cited example but not the uniqueness invariant is rejected.

evals.name: pass-requires-rerunning-reviewer-reproducer
evals.given: The producer replaces the heuristic with a loop whose exit condition is the uniqueness invariant and claims the finding is resolved.
evals.then: The reviewer re-runs their own round-2 reproducer against HEAD (not a new argument); all synthetic attachments survive at distinct deterministic paths; only then does the round return PASS and the label flip to verified.

evals.name: round-count-is-floor-not-ceiling
evals.given: min_rounds=2 and round 2 returned FAIL with one open finding.
evals.when: The loop decides whether to terminate.
evals.then: The loop continues to round 3 despite the floor being met; it terminates only on a zero-finding PASS round, and the PR's posted round table records all three verdicts.

evals.name: wrong-runner-false-fail-caught
evals.given: The reviewer runs a PEP-723 inline-dependency script with bare python and reports missing-dependency failures as a finding.
evals.when: The producer checks the recorded run command against the reviewer's command.
evals.then: The finding is reclassified as a reviewer-environment error (wrong runner), the exact command (uv run + env vars) is restated in the round prompt, and the round is re-run rather than the change being 'fixed' for a false FAIL.
